en: So what is sorting? What are the algorithms
in this module all about?
Well, this should be fairly straightforward.
Sorting, of course, is about having an array
full of data which is unsorted, so which is
not in the order you want it to be.
And then with the right sorting algorithm,
you can efficiently derive a new array that
is sorted. So where the items are put into
order. And of course, you can sort them in
an ascending or descending way, but that's
totally up to you.
The algorithms will always work in the same
way though.
Now, in this module, we'll have a look at
various algorithms that help us achieve that
goal of sorting items.
And being able to sort lists, so to sort
arrays, is of course super important because
often in programming, you have other tasks
like finding elements or splitting lists or
doing anything else that need sorted data.
So let's explore various sorting algorithms
then.
